==========================================================================
:class:`~pcapkit.protocols.link.ieee802_11.IEEE802_11` Vendor Crawlers
==========================================================================

.. module:: pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11

This module contains all vendor crawlers of
:class:`~pcapkit.protocols.link.ieee802_11.IEEE802_11` implementations.
Available vendor crawlers include:

.. list-table::

   * - :class:`IEEE802_11_Type <pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11.type.Type>`
     - Frame Types
   * - :class:`IEEE802_11_ManagementSubtype <pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11.management_subtype.ManagementSubtype>`
     - Management Frame Subtypes
   * - :class:`IEEE802_11_ControlSubtype <pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11.control_subtype.ControlSubtype>`
     - Control Frame Subtypes
   * - :class:`IEEE802_11_DataSubtype <pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11.data_subtype.DataSubtype>`
     - Data Frame Subtypes
   * - :class:`IEEE802_11_ExtensionSubtype <pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11.extension_subtype.ExtensionSubtype>`
     - Extension Frame Subtypes

.. note::

   These crawlers do not crawl. IEEE Std 802.11-2020 assigns the frame type
   and subtype values in Table 9-1 of the standard's text, and neither IEEE
   nor IANA publishes them as a machine-readable registry, so each crawler
   reads a ``DATA`` literal and defines no ``LINK``
   (:ref:`const-vendor-pairing`). Each ``DATA`` is transcribed from the table
   on Wikipedia's *802.11 frame types* page [*]_, which reproduces Table 9-1
   with the Trigger frame of IEEE Std 802.11ax-2021.

Frame Types
===========

.. module:: pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11.type

This module contains the vendor crawler for **IEEE 802.11 Frame Types**,
which is automatically generating :class:`pcapkit.const.ieee802_11.type.Type`.

.. autoclass:: pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11.type.Type
   :members: FLAG
   :show-inheritance:
